name: Tunnel
description: The polar tunnel — 1/r is depth, angle wraps the wall, and no geometry exists at all. Panelled walls whose cross-section pumps on the low end, strip lights running the length of it, hoops passing on the bar, sparks blowing past and a lit throat at the far end.

wobble.description: How far the flight path curves off centre.

pulse.description: How hard the cross-section breathes on the low end. 0 gives a perfectly round tunnel, which is the old flat version.

strips.description: Strip lights running the length of the corridor. These are what the eye travels along.

disperse.description: Per-channel offset of the wall's palette lookup. A little of it stops the far end reading as flat colour.
